senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; בּוֹשׁ) (freq. with פנים) shame, insult; bashfulness, chastity.
units: Keth. 67ᵇ בּוֹשְׁתָּהּ של וכ׳ the shame of a woman (in remaining single).—Trnsf. (sub. דמי) indemnity for exposure.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 8:1">B. Kam. VIII, 1</cite> sq.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 85b:7">Ib. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ דרק ליה וכ׳</he> an indictable insult (without physical injury) is (e.g.) spitting in one’s face.
Y. Yeb. VI, 7ᵇ, a. fr. בית הב׳ pudenda.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14:3">Lev. R. s. 14</cite> <he>במקום בָּשְׁתָּהּ</he> near her pudenda.
